post.title: Blue-Green Deployment Pattern: Safe Cutovers with Instant Rollback
post.subtitle: Run parallel environments and switch traffic atomically to reduce release risk.
post.brief: Blue-green deployment reduces release risk by preparing the new environment completely before traffic moves. It is most effective when rollback is a routing change, not a rebuild.
